item.title: Ginza Omakase Sushi — Guide
item.description: Ginza, Tokyo’s most prestigious shopping and dining district, is home to some of the world’s finest sushi restaurants, and experiencing an omakase (chef’s choice) meal here is a bucket-list Tokyo indulgence. At an intimate sushi counter, the chef (itamae) serves a carefully sequenced procession of nigiri and other dishes, choosing the very best seasonal seafood — sourced from top markets — and preparing each piece by hand right in front of you, placing it on your counter to be eaten immediately at the peak of freshness and temperature.
